description: An engineering change manager must authorize temporary use of an alternate locating fixture on Assembly Cell 2 and finalize the validation, clamping, inspection, and operator-control plan before production resumes.

shared_context.S1: The locating fixture normally used on Assembly Cell 2 cracked during the last shift, and an alternate fixture is available in the tooling crib.
shared_context.S2: The alternate fixture is generally suitable for the cell's product family, but it has not yet been released for this production order.
shared_context.S3: Temporary tooling changes require documented validation, an operator briefing, and defined controls before production resumes.
shared_context.S4: Mara makes the binding authorization decision, and the daily engineering change review includes a routine check with quality and tooling before the decision is recorded.
shared_context.S5: The engineering change procedure permits Mara to authorize a temporary run with documentation, briefing, and control requirements recorded as commitments to complete before production resumes.

PF1.text: Jon's dimensional review of the alternate fixture found a 0.18 mm locating-pin offset; the product tolerance can still be demonstrated only by measuring the first 10 units with a CMM, but he has not uploaded the review to the engineering change record yet.

PF2.text: Priya's tooling inspection found that the alternate fixture's clamp must be set to exactly 32 Nm and re-inspected every 4 hours during the temporary run; she has not entered those settings in the cell setup sheet yet.

acceptance_conditions: The alternate fixture must be authorized for the production order, with remaining documentation and briefing requirements recorded as commitments.
The first 10 units must receive CMM measurement before release.
The temporary-run clamp setting must be exactly 32 Nm.
The alternate fixture must be re-inspected every 4 hours.
A documented validation commitment and an operator briefing or briefing-preparation commitment must be recorded.
Jon's dimensional finding must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C6: any(c.get('type') in ['documentation', 'documented_validation', 'defined_controls', 'temporary_tooling_change_authorization'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c.get('type') in ['briefing', 'operator_briefing', 'briefing_material', 'operator_briefing_coordination'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The exact 0.18 mm offset changes the release plan from ordinary approval to mandatory CMM measurement of exactly 10 units and supplies the finding that must be cited.
The tooling inspection changes the setup to exactly 32 Nm clamp torque and an exact 4-hour re-inspection interval instead of an unspecified temporary-fixture setup.
